Tactile Power Absorption

The Parasite's (DCAU/Superman: The Animated Series) touch allowed him to steal the powers of others.

Power/Ability to:

Steal powers of others through touch.

The power to absorb or steal powers from others through physical touch or contact. Variation of Power Absorption and Powerful Touch. Not to be confused with Visual Power Replication.

Also Called[]

  • Ability Absorption/Assimilation/Drain/Draining/Siphoning/Stealing/Theft Touch
  • Power Assimilation/Drain/Draining/Sapping/Siphoning/Stealing/Theft Touch

Capabilities[]

Users can absorb powers and supernatural abilities from others through physical contact. The effects may be temporary; however, some users may be able to absorb powers permanently.

Applications[]

  • Ability Information Archiving
  • Absolute/Enhanced/Superpower Replication(Varies)
  • Energy Absorption/Drain
  • Intuitive Absorption
    • Enhanced Grip/Supernatural Grip
  • Power Erasure
    • Power Destruction
  • Power Negation/Reduction
  • Power Containment
    • Self-Power Augmentation only when absorbing the same power or ability.
    • Self-Power Bestowal by transferring the absorb power into themselves.
  • Multi-Power Use
  • Power Mixture by combining absorbed powers.
  • Talent Theft
  • Potential Theft
  • Usurp Worth

Associations[]

  • Absorption
  • Anti-Power Weaponry
  • Consumptive Replication
  • Death-Force Absorption
  • Life-Force Absorption

Limitations[]

  • Users require physical contact for the ability to work.
